query:
SELECT COUNT(*) filter (
  where proposed_page_edits.pending = true
) AS pending,
COUNT(*) filter (
  where proposed_page_edits.pending = false
) AS handled
FROM proposed_page_edits
WHERE proposed_page_edits.course_id = $1
AND created_at >= $2
AND created_at <= $3
AND proposed_page_edits.deleted_at IS NULL
